title: Case: Import broker needs the consignee to appoint it before processing
context: The broker has not been appointed. The consignee’s authorised director must complete its stated mandate process before the broker can act.
initial_request: Account register excerpt: Mara Vesk, director, is the authorised signatory for broker appointment on DL-5344. Her verified business-portal channel is active. Please ask her to complete the mandate; our operator account cannot sign it.

events.body: This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
DL-74312 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

DL-5344 is waiting for a consignee mandate. Our fictional procedure requires the registered authorised signatory to accept the shipment-specific mandate in the verified business portal. No passport or banking credentials are required in this exercise.

Thanks,
Greer
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the consignee's authorised representative to complete the broker's stated appointment process.

must_not: Director title alone is not authority; the independent account register and verified acceptance establish this limited appointment.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please complete Glimmerton’s shipment-specific broker mandate for DL-5344 through your verified business portal. The account register records your signing authority; the broker must confirm acceptance.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-046: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
